items.message: ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL is read and stored in registration settings before the monkeypatched-empty environment is restored, but the timing depends on when default_registry() is called relative to GATE-AUTH-1's env-empty window.

Unknown-destination check precedes the data-policy check, so a restricted repo with endpoint=None and DataPolicy.INTERNAL raises residency.unknown_destination; this is the intended behavior per the gate description, but the error message could expose the internal registration reason string to callers.
